window.restore: Plugin Restore window returned maximized false
window.fullscreen: Plugin Enter full screen set fullscreen true; Exit full screen returned fullscreen/maximized false and focused true

window.foreground: After actual fullscreen entry/exit, document.visibilityState was visible and dialog opacity was 1; normal-window screenshots were visually inspected

defectFixed.component: packages/ui/src/DefinitionList.tsx, consumed by plugin keyValue rendering
defectFixed.before: At 600x750 logical pixels, the full source hash had scrollWidth 568 versus clientWidth 261; ancestor definition list had scrollWidth 677 versus clientWidth 370
defectFixed.fix: Keep grid items shrinkable and wrap unbroken labels/values anywhere. Do not truncate or modify stored identifiers
defectFixed.after: At 600x750 the complete hash had scrollWidth/clientWidth 261/261 and computed overflow-wrap:anywhere. No overflowing descendants in the dialog at 600x750 or 900x650; visibility visible and opacity 1
defectFixed.regression: Added LongIdentifiers Storybook case with a full source hash and long unbroken label/value; UI and web typechecks passed; actual Tauri geometry and screenshot rechecked

cleanup.privateDocuments: Owned-book filter only; empty after cleanup
cleanup.plugins: Jumper and Workspace Profiles retained original enabled state true
cleanup.processes: Owned PID 54580 terminated, driver 9224 stopped, frontend session exited 0; no 5184/9224 listeners

limitations: Agent calls were scripted tool invocations with the real approval adapter/widget and Worker, not a complete model-driven chat turn. No inference request or chat message was sent.
No fresh plugin upgrade-consent flow, selection bookmark, multiple-format bookmark, cross-book switch, cross-device sync or crash-durability claim.
Initial background-window DOM/native-state checks do not prove foreground visuals. Only settled visible screenshots are accepted; an early transition screenshot was replaced.
Shared UI HMR reloaded the frontend and cleared fixture ownership. Re-prepared the exact existing owned book before cleanup; did not recreate test data or restart because of observation failure.

One post-restart scoped DOM snapshot failed with resolveAll unavailable; an unscoped retry on the same live app succeeded. A follow-up command used display-qualified jumper:bookmarks instead of internal bookmarks and was corrected without product changes.
Automation bridge cannot report its plugin version. No bridge upgrade was attempted. This batch does not certify every capability or remaining acceptance scenario.
